tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{for(i=1;i<=3;i++){k="'$i; s[k]+=$4; if($4>0)p[k]+=$4; else n[k]-=$4}} END{for(k in s) printf "%+d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -40
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[1],.value]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1" | "$2;s[k]+=$3;if($3>0)p[k]+=$3;else n[k]-=$3} END{for(k in s)printf "%+d'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%s\\n\",s[k],p[k],n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[2]==\"action:scroll\" or .stack_frames[2]==\"action:noop\" or .stack_frames[2]==\"action:click\") | [.stack_frames[2],(if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end),(.value|fabs),.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$1 SUBSEP $2; ops[k]+=$3; seen[k SUBSEP $4]=1} END{for(k in ops){split(k,a,SUBSEP); ns=0; for(x in seen){split(x,b,SUBSEP);if(b[1]==a[1]&&b[2]==a[2])ns++} print a[1],a[2],ops[k],ns}}'"' | sort
jq -r '[if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end, (.value|fabs)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2;n[$1]++} END{for(k in s)print k,s[k],n[k]}'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[if .value>0 then \"bad\" else \"good\" end,.labels.source_session[0],(.value|fabs),(.stack_frames[2]==\"action:scroll\")]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{key="'$1 SUBSEP $2; total[key]+=$3; side[key]=$1;if($4=="true")scroll[key]+=$3} END{for(k in total){s=side[k]; sessions[s]++; ops[s]+=total[k]; sc[s]+=scroll[k]; if(scroll[k]>=2) rep[s]++; if(scroll[k]>0) any[s]++} for(s in sessions) printf "%s sessions=%d operations=%d scrolls=%d scroll_share=%.4f any_scroll=%d repeated_scroll_sessions=%d'"\\n\",s,sessions[s],ops[s],sc[s],sc[s]/ops[s],any[s],rep[s]}' | sort"
